saved_verification_receipts.scope: Frozen protocol, complete test IDs/control pairs, references, edit counts, corpus WER/MOS aggregates, generation records, finite projected traces; source/WAV contents and WAV headers when hash_audio=True. ASR and quality models were not rerun.

Three previously studied settings on the existing fixed 24-clip development pilot. Explicit reflected padding and strict math generation; native saved-audio ASR and fixed MOS scorers. No learning-rate grid, subset changes, automatic promotion, fresh confirmation or 999-clip test. Cached native scores are descriptive context, not paired same-run controls.

Full-trajectory diagnostic ablations on the same fixed 24 development clips: remove TV, remove HF, remove both perceptual terms. Fixed rho=.1, lambda=1, alpha=1, Adam LR=.1, fifty updates, native references/decoder/scorers and strict explicit-reflection generation. Cached repeatable full-objective control; no parameter selection, candidate promotion, fresh48 or 999 test. Ablated objectives cannot establish reproduction of the full paper objective.

optimization_coordinates.normalization: unit RMS in CPU float64, then cast to q dtype
optimization_coordinates.mapping: delta = weights * theta; optimize theta with Adam
optimization_coordinates.projection: radial projection of physical delta onto original q-relative L2 ball

saved_verification_receipts.scope: Two predefined clean-statistic optimizer coordinates on the fixed 24 development clips. Matched raw WavLM layer-6/regular HiFi-GAN, original sum NLL/full perceptual loss, rho=.1, lambda=1, alpha=1, fc=6000, zero initialization, Adam LR=.1, fifty updates. Positive weights change Adam coordinates, not the physical feasible set or loss. Native references/decoding/scorers and strict explicit-reflection differentiation retained. The pilot is repeatedly used development data. No sample selection, weight grid, automatic fresh48/999 evaluation or claim of author-recipe recovery or human sound quality.
